paragraphs.text: Dietitians often ask their clients to keep a food diary for one week. Writing down everything you eat helps you notice habits, such as snacking in the evening, that you might otherwise miss. Most people find that they eat more than they thought.

items.quote: Dietitians often ask their clients to keep a food diary for one week
items.prompt: Clients of a dietitian are often asked

explanation.en: Dietitians ask clients to “keep a food diary for one week” → A. D fits the grammar (“asked to …”), but evening snacking is an example of a habit, not a rule.
explanation.kk: Диетологтар клиенттерден «keep a food diary for one week» сұрайды → A. D грамматикалық жағынан келеді («asked to …»), бірақ мәтінде кешкі тамақтану — тыйым емес, әдеттің мысалы.
explanation.ru: Диетологи просят клиентов «keep a food diary for one week» → A. D грамматически подходит («asked to …»), но в тексте перекусы по вечерам — пример привычки, а не запрет.

items.quote: Writing down everything you eat helps you notice habits

explanation.en: “Writing down everything you eat helps you notice habits” → B. C contradicts the text: people eat more, not less.
explanation.kk: «Writing down everything you eat helps you notice habits» → B. C мәтінге қайшы: адамдар аз емес, көп жейді.
explanation.ru: «Writing down everything you eat helps you notice habits» → B. C противоречит тексту: люди едят больше, а не меньше.

options.text: to record everything they eat for a week.
helps people notice their eating habits.
shows that most people eat less than they expected.
to stop eating in the evening.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A–D, from the box below.

steps.en: “Clients of a dietitian are often asked” needs a “to …” ending. A and D fit the grammar.
steps.kk: «Clients of a dietitian are often asked» басы «to …» жалғасын талап етеді. A мен D сай келеді.
steps.ru: Начало «Clients of a dietitian are often asked» требует продолжения с «to …». Подходят A и D.

steps.en: Check the text: “Dietitians often ask their clients to keep a food diary for one week”.
steps.kk: Мәтінмен салыстырамыз: «Dietitians often ask their clients to keep a food diary for one week».
steps.ru: Сверяем с текстом: «Dietitians often ask their clients to keep a food diary for one week».

steps.en: Only A matches the meaning. Evening snacking is an example, not a request → A.
steps.kk: Мағынасы жағынан тек A сай. Кешкі тамақтану — мәтінде өтініш емес, мысал → A.
steps.ru: По смыслу подходит только A. Вечерние перекусы в тексте — пример, а не просьба → A.

steps.en: “Writing down everything you eat” is a subject, so we need a verb ending: B or C.
steps.kk: «Writing down everything you eat» — бастауыш, етістікті соңы керек: B не C.
steps.ru: Начало «Writing down everything you eat» — подлежащее, нужно окончание с глаголом: B или C.

steps.en: The text: “helps you notice habits” and “Most people find that they eat more than they thought”.
steps.kk: Мәтінде: «helps you notice habits» және «Most people find that they eat more than they thought».
steps.ru: В тексте: «helps you notice habits» и «Most people find that they eat more than they thought».

steps.en: C says “less”, which contradicts the text. The answer is B.
steps.kk: C «less» дейді — мәтінге қайшы. Жауап — B.
steps.ru: C говорит «less» — это противоречит тексту. Ответ B.
